entries.title: Dissertation Viva Voce Defense
entries.caption: Dissertation day, after the viva voce was defended successfully. The external panel engaged deeply on how cognitive offloading habits in young engineers differ from older demographic baselines.

entries.title: Field Administration of Spatial Memory Protocol
entries.caption: Administering the unguided campus wayfinding challenge to undergraduate participants. Observing how quickly participants intuitively reached for phones when orientation vectors turned complex.

entries.title: Cognitive Failures Survey Debriefing Session
entries.caption: Facilitating an open post-test reflection circle with engineering students on metacognitive awareness, subjective distraction, and working memory hygiene.

workshops.title: Cognitive Ergonomics & Mental Offloading in Code Generation
workshops.description: Interactive demonstration on how code autocompletion and conversational AI alter programming problem-solving pathways and spatial code architecture retention.

workshops.title: Psychometrics in Human-Centered AI Evaluation
workshops.description: Bridging quantitative engineering metrics (F1 score, latency) with human perceptual measures (NASA-TLX cognitive workload, CFQ error rates).
